limitations_after_comparison: Added value is measured only against unchanged integrity-rules v1 on large, known generated injections; a strengthened deterministic consistency check was not evaluated and may provide the same signal. Compare that alternative before any ML adoption.
Zero false flags on 16 generated clean test cases does not estimate a zero real-drive false-positive rate or establish subgroup/generalization safety.
Lowering the frozen threshold to the predeclared 0.5 sensitivity diagnostic flags 2/16 clean cases; diagnostics were not used to change the selected threshold.
Native platform-signal and corruption handling remain necessary: the model flags 0/2 mock-signal cases and abstains on all 4 raw-corruption cases.
M7.4 acceptance, M7.5 real-model integration, physical/vehicle/M6.8 and production feature/data/runtime/battery gates remain open.
Clean families are predeclared governed fixtures already expected to be verified by the native rules. Their zero native false flags are not independent validation on representative legitimate drives.

limitations: Generated-only experiment. Fictional profile holdout and shared templates are not independent real-driver, route, device, mount or vehicle evidence.
Whole-trip source-summary features discard direction, localized timing and many physical relationships; not a production feature contract.
Known injection labels are generated operations, not evidence of malicious intent, real attacks or field integrity truth.
Quality limitations, platform signals and raw corruption remain distinct; decoder failures abstain from model inference rather than receiving fabricated features.
Real legitimate-drive false-positive rate, calibrated anomaly probability, production usefulness, mobile latency and battery cost remain unavailable.
No model output changes deterministic integrity/ranking, event/scoring or safety behavior. Previous model acceptance gates remain open.
